messages.body: One bug, in `incr`: the read `self._counts.get(name, 0)` happens outside the lock. Two threads calling `incr("hits")` at once can both read 0 and both write 1, so one increment is lost even though the docstring says it is thread-safe. Fix: move the read inside the `with self._lock:` block. `get` and `snapshot` are fine. I'd withdraw this only if every caller is already serialised by some outer lock.
